steps.text: On iPhone or iPad, open Settings and tap your name.
Tap the subscription you want to stop.

steps.note: If you do not see Cancel, the subscription is already stopped or another party bills it.

steps.text: On a Mac, open the App Store app, click your name, then Account Settings. Click Manage next to Subscriptions.
Or use the Apple page for subscriptions on the web and sign in with your Apple Account.
steps.note: Apple changes this page. Search Apple Support for cancel a subscription if you cannot find it.

steps.text: A third party, including StopDate, cannot cancel an Apple subscription for you.
steps.note: Only you can do this with your Apple Account.
